name: Eager — Level 4 Catastrophe Scout Player Character

details.appearance: A Toad-shaped field companion of uncertain ancestry. Eager is often found in spider silk, a bad room, a collapsing estate, or the exact place the party was hoping not to go.
details.trait: I just follow people. What do you think, Markop?
details.ideal: No one gets left in the nest. If I am already there, the rescue has started.
details.bond: The people who keep coming back for me, and the people I keep following back into trouble.
details.flaw: I panic, miss, and make terrible entrances; then I stay long enough to be useful.
details.eyes: Alert, usually wider than the situation warrants

languages.custom: Field jargon and enough Toad network shorthand to trade arrows.

weaponProf.custom: Simple and martial weapons; shortbow and dagger

biography.value:
Eager — Player Character Dossier

Level 4 Catastrophe Scout. Eager is the player-character who was cocooned fifteen feet above the Silent Grove, whose rescue triggered the Battle of the Spider Grove, who used pepper spray on spiders while enlarged, who missed at the Tree of Woe, wore a dead person's shoes and pants during the Shadow Estate chase, and who stayed in the cottage guard rotation after the universe repeatedly proved it wanted him elsewhere.

Ledger: 4,860 XP, 25 entries, Level 4, Power 10 Elite, Fame 34 Local. The XP ledger remains authoritative.

How to play Eager

Eager is not fearless and is not a joke NPC. He is frightened, resourceful, loyal, and still present. He follows the party into danger, uses the strange tool he happens to have, and turns an embarrassing failure into a second chance. The inventory is deliberately limited to confirmed gear from the source record.

Confirmed inventory

Eager carries a shortbow, arrows, a dagger, pepper spray, the shoes and pants he acquired during the Shadow Estate chase, and ordinary field clothing. He does not own the party's Black Crystal, the Mirror of True Reflection, the Orb of Shadow Domination, the Umbral Signet, or Remi's Feather Fall. Those remain source-history objects.
biography.public: Eager is the catastrophe magnet: rescue him and a battle begins, but he may be carrying exactly the absurd tool that saves the party.

description.value: Level 4 fighter interpretation of Eager's repeated combat, perimeter, survival, and improvised-tool actions. The Scout subtitle is campaign flavor, not a new NPC stat block.
Eager's ancestry is unconfirmed. Use Medium Toad as the table-facing interpretation without inventing a family or planar origin.
A field background for rescue, perimeter work, survival, and following the party into places that have already begun to collapse.
Eager is trained to use ranged weapons under pressure. Gain the standard Archery fighting-style bonus when using a ranged weapon.
Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. Uses are tracked in the primary resource.
Once per short or long rest, take one additional action on the turn. Uses are tracked in the secondary resource.
Danger finds Eager. When the GM places a complication in the scene, Eager may be the first to notice or trigger it; this is narrative positioning, not automatic damage.
Eager has been cocooned, rescued, enlarged, and returned to the fight. Gain advantage on one check per rest to resist restraint, webbing, or panic after being captured.
Eager can use pepper spray against creatures with eyes or scent-based coordination. On a failed Constitution save, a target is blinded or disoriented at GM discretion. The spray has limited uses.
Eager can take a watch position and call out movement even while frightened. He does not need to be fearless to remain on guard.
Once per long rest, after failing an attack or check while frightened, Eager can move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make a new Perception or Survival check.
Eager was a passenger in Remi's Feather Fall escape. This is a learned evacuation procedure, not a spell or owned item. He knows to grab the chain and stay with the group.
Where Eager is, a problem is probably nearby. The party may gain a clue, rescue opportunity, or treasure lead by following the disaster.
A dagger Eager carried and offered to Remi to draw blood from the spider beast.
A shortbow representing Eager's repeated arrow fire and perimeter support. The source calls his ranged weapon inconsistently; the sheet uses a shortbow for the player loadout.
A limited-use canister Eager used successfully against smaller spiders while enlarged. It is mundane field equipment with a campaign-specific effect.

activation.condition: Creature must be Small or Medium.
Creature must be Small or Medium.

description.value: Shoes Eager found in the chess room and wore during the Shadow Estate chase. He said it felt wrong. He wore them anyway.
Pants Eager acquired during the Shadow Estate chase. Markop observed that Eager was wearing a dead man's clothing; Eager replied that pants are important.
